newsitem.title: USA: HUBCO requested S&P not issue rating.
newsitem.headline: HUBCO requested S&P not issue rating.

text.p: HUBCO Inc said that Standard & Poor's BB+ rating of its $75 million private placement of subordinated debt due 2006 was unexpected and unsolicited and it had asked not to be rated.

"When Standard & Poor's Inc faxed a copy of their unexpected and unsolicited rating to me on Wednesday, September 18, I requested that they not issue the rating, or that they meet with representatives of HUBCO Inc before determining a rating," chairman, president and chief executive officer Kenneth Neilson said. "But I was rebuffed."
A Standard & Poor's spokesman declined to comment, except that it is confident in its analytical judgement.

The Standard & Poor's report said yesterday that HUBCO has improved its risk profile through an aggressive acquisition policy, but the firm was concerned about operational and control issues from its growth. The report said the bank's outlook is stable.
